songs.name: And We Bid You Good Night

ai_show_review.summary: Blazing Eleven, fierce Alligator‑Caution jam, tight rhythm section
ai_show_review.blurb: The set rockets off with Dark Star into Saint Stephen and The Eleven, delivering a high‑energy peak. A scorching Alligator‑Caution sequence showcases Jerry’s red‑hot guitar and the dual drums lock in tight. Recording quality is superb, making this a must‑listen 1969 performance.
ai_show_review.review: On February 12, 1969 at New York’s Fillmore East the Dead unleashed one of their most electrifying late‑show sets. The early trio – Dark Star, Saint Stephen and The Eleven – launches the concert at peak intensity, with Garcia in a "red‑hot" twin‑tone frenzy and Phil Lesh laying down his “harmony‑geometric genius” bass lines that drive the jams forward. After a soulful rendition of Death Don’t Have No Mercy the band dives into an all‑out Alligator–Caution adventure; Tom Constanten’s subtle, cello‑like feedback underpins the improvisation while Mickey Hart and Bill Kreutzmann provide crystal‑clear, punchy drumming that keeps the momentum blazing. The show closes with a wild Feedback segue and a gentle Good Night, captured in superb soundboard clarity that makes every nuance of this historic 1969 performance shine.

best_recording.reason: Excellent soundboard source with superb, crisp audio and clear instrument separation, especially the drums.

key_highlights: The Eleven – soaring, rhythmically complex showcase.
Alligator > Caution jam – scorching improvisation with cello‑like feedback tone.
St. Stephen > The Eleven transition – launches the set at peak energy.
Dark Star (partial) – hints of the cosmic journey despite a missing opening.

band_performance.Jerry: Garcia is red‑hot, roaring twin‑tone with blazing fast runs and fire soloing, especially on The Eleven.
band_performance.Phil: Lesh delivers harmony‑geometric genius, driving the high‑energy jams with perfect bass lines.
band_performance.Mickey: Drums are clear and punchy; his interplay with Bill creates a solid rhythmic foundation.
band_performance.Billy: Provides tight, punchy drumming that meshes perfectly with Mickey for a powerful dual‑drum groove.

must_listen_sequences: And We Bid You Good Night
